summary: 10.0.34.12 Enterprise Release - Full Desktop Parity for Bank & Expense, Bank Statement Reconciliation, Categorized Actions Context Menu, and Screenshot 5 Linked Transactions Modal
highlights: 1. Bank & Expense Module (BankExpense.fxml Parity): Unified workspace, in-place mode switching, dynamic 4 KPIs with grey/green/orange/blue pills, FY date pickers, bill attachment uploader, and dynamic lookups via MasterService
2. Bank Statement Reconciliation (BankStatement.fxml Parity): Account masking, 8 Title Case KPIs, 3-row filter toolbar with batch progress bar, guidance banner, and 50/100/200 pagination

3. Categorized Context Menu (Screenshot 4 Parity): VIEW (Transaction Details with 500-char ERP note editor, Imported Statement with raw CSV and SHA-256 fingerprint copy, Audit History), RECONCILIATION (View Match/Linked Record, Review Suggested Match, Move to Expense, View Bank Entry), REVERSAL (Unmatch/Reverse), and STATUS (Mark for Review, Mark as Ignored)

4. Linked Transactions Modal (Screenshot 5 Parity): Information modal with 5 metric cards (Bank Ref, Linked Count, Bank Linked, Round-off, Difference), multi-allocation table with direct workflow navigation
5. Modals & Safety: 1040px Browse Statements History dialog with 4 filters, two-step DELETE confirmation safety modal, reason prompt dialogs for review/ignore, and bulk move dialog
